about: What combat must get right, a row a criterion (tools/combat/README.md): what a player notices, its bar and source, the check that measures it, cheap (seconds, CPU) or heavy (the GPU film), whether it is measurable yet. `noticed` is how much a player notices it, 5 most; the scorecard orders failing rows by it (the task list).

criteria.notice: a light blow lands late after the press: the sword feels sluggish
the second blow of the chain comes too soon or drags after the first
the chain's last blow comes too soon or drags after the second
the light chain ends a blow early
the chain's last blow snaps back to guard instead of landing with weight
a heavy blow lands too fast to read as heavy, or too slow to use
after a heavy blow lands the player waits too long to act
a heavy blow takes too long from press to guard
the roll lasts too long: the player feels stuck in it
a second roll comes too soon or too late after the first
the slash freezes on a hit where Enshrouded flashes and kicks the camera
the backhand freezes on a hit where Enshrouded flashes and kicks the camera
the finisher freezes on a hit where Enshrouded flashes and kicks the camera
the heavy freezes on a hit where Enshrouded flashes and kicks the camera
the partner's slash lands before the player can read it and answer
the partner's heavy lands before the player can read it and answer
fighters trade blows too close or too far apart
the sword or shield passes through the body in the slash
the sword (blade, guard or hilt) goes through the fighter's own shield (slash)
criteria.source: D481 (moves.ts clash, clash.ts); the developer's note on the duel film, 2026-10-25

criteria.notice: an arm sinks into the body in the air drawn (Jump_Loop)
a press during a blow is lost instead of starting the next of the chain
a press long before a blow's window starts a blow the player no longer wants
a guard raised just in time does not parry
a roll is hit in its middle, or untouchable while getting up
the shield stops a blow from behind, or fails one from the side
a hit does not flinch the struck, or a parry does not stagger the attacker
a reeling body acts before its reel has run
a hit-stop freezes the whole world, not the bodies in it
a blow lunges past the foe or falls short
a blow lands on a foe out of its reach, or a roll strikes
a fast blade passes through a foe without striking
a blow strikes without a wind-up to read
the scripted duel does not chain, land, parry, dodge and tire as written
a blow or roll costs no stamina, or a heavy no more than a light
out of stamina, a roll or heavy still starts, or nothing does
a tired light blow is as fast and hard as a rested one
a blow on a guard with too little stamina does not break it
drawn, a roll or blow costs nothing, or a tired one starts
a blow on the shield's face, its boss and the body are not told apart
a contact makes no sound, or the same sound whatever is struck and however hard
two runs of one script fight differently (the fight is not repeatable)
a press starts its move late
the player stands idle between two blows of a chain
planted feet slide over the ground
the fighters' bodies pass into each other
a blow in reach passes through the foe without landing
a hit holds the striker for the wrong time
the fight drifts out of the films' cameras
the game's camera frames the player too large, too small or off the middle
locked on, the camera stands straight behind the player and the foe hides behind them
criteria.source: D453 (15-20 degrees to one side of the line to the target)

the body snaps back into the guard as the shield comes down

criteria.notice: a lone light blow returns to guard too fast or slow
criteria.needs: a lone light blow back to guard in third-party footage

criteria.notice: a landed blow lights the whole struck body, a 2D game's convention our reference does not show (the struck body keeps its colours; the hit shows at the contact, hit.burst.frames)
criteria.source: D487 (Decided: the contact burst alone); research/2026-10-25-what-a-landed-hit-shows.md (Enshrouded's dummy keeps its colours on every frame, 247.717-247.783 s)

criteria.notice: a landed blow does not kick the camera, or kicks it so hard the fight is hard to follow
criteria.source: D456 (a small kick of the camera); Enshrouded's size is not measured (refs/enshrouded.json hit_stop.note: the sky moves 3 to 8 of 255 a frame), so the bar runs from a few pixels (0.3 deg, about 6 at 1080 lines and 55 deg) to a kick that stays small (1.5 deg)

criteria.notice: the camera's kick on a landed blow lingers, or is gone before it is seen
criteria.source: D456; tools/combat/refs/enshrouded.json hit_stop.note (the camera kicks from 247.67 to 247.77 s, still before and after: about 0.1 s)

criteria.notice: a landed blow shows nothing where the blade met the body, or a glow that lingers there
criteria.source: D487; tools/combat/refs/enshrouded.json hit_stop.flash_frames_at_60 (3-4), the glow at the contact, 247.717-247.767 s (research/2026-10-25-what-a-landed-hit-shows.md)

criteria.notice: the partner's wind-up cannot be read from the player's camera
criteria.needs: a film check of the partner's wind-up seen from the game's camera

criteria.notice: the shield floats up over the shoulder like a sail while the sword swings
criteria.source: Enshrouded ftp 245.40-247.20 s (the shield's middle at the belly to the lower chest through a chained light blow); I.33 fol. 1r (the buckler forward at the chest); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md

criteria.notice: the shield arm is held up like a wing, the elbow at the shoulder and the forearm straight up
criteria.source: Enshrouded ftp 245.40-247.20 s (the shield arm's elbow by the waist, the forearm forward); Mordhau, Elden Ring (recalled: the shield arm low at the side between blocks); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md

criteria.notice: the shield's painted face turns back toward the camera behind the player during a blow
criteria.source: Enshrouded ftp 245.40-247.20 s (the face forward and out to the left, oblique); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md

criteria.notice: the shield snaps back in toward the body and out again as the next blow of the chain starts
criteria.source: D447 (moves.ts CHAIN_M); Enshrouded ftp 245.47-247.20 s (the shield stays out at the side between chained blows); the duel film r17 record frames 298-306 and 338-356 (round trips of about 0.13 and 0.2 s); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md

criteria.notice: the shield jumps in and out at a move change (a chained blow, a parried blow's stagger, the block)
criteria.source: the duel film r17 (record frames 298-306, 338-356, the parried heavy's stagger 458-464); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md
criteria.needs: the fight record (terra_creatures::melee, --fight-log) to carry each fighter's shield middle each frame, and duel.ts --check to count shield paths that leave and come back more than 0.1 m within 0.3 s of a move change; a film check named shield round trips

criteria.notice: the fist is off the shield's hand strap: a strapped shield (D504) is held by the forearm through its arm strap and the fist closed on its hand strap, and the fist hangs away from it
criteria.source: D504 and D459 (a strapped heater, its enarmes: the forearm through the arm strap, the fist on the hand strap; the look's origin is the hand strap, fit_held.py STRAPS); docs/holding.md section 3 (the hand closes on the handle; IK only past 1 cm); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md. Redefined in round 24 from the round shield's centre grip

criteria.notice: the fist cannot close on the shield's hand strap: the strap, across the board square to the forearm, runs into the hand instead of across the palm
criteria.source: D504 and D459 (a strapped heater's hand strap runs across its board, square to the forearm, and lies across the palm of the fist that holds it: the look's +X, fit_held.py TEXTURED); research/2026-10-25-shield-prior-art.md. Redefined in round 24 from the round shield's centre-grip bar
